name: Legends Buzz
summary: Self-hosted Block Buzz relay operations, 26-domain MCP-to-CLI agent routing, Nostr NIP-OA/NIP-FI membership diagnostics, and desktop PE/asset verification.
outcomes: Route all 26 Block Buzz domains and 108 subcommands through the native buzz CLI (--format agent) without an ambient MCP daemon
Deploy and upgrade self-hosted Buzz relays (PostgreSQL 17, Redis 7, Blossom, Traefik/Caddy) with @sha256 digest pinning, isolated --internal clone migration rehearsals, and 9 production blueprints

Probe all 6 live relay surfaces (/_readiness, /health, NIP-11, tauri://localhost CORS, /invite/* CSP edge, and /pair RFC 6455 WebSocket 101) and diagnose residual HTTP 403 membership gaps (/invite/<token>), NIP-FI gates, and Bech32 npub1.../hex64 owner governance coverage
Reconstruct isolated Nostr kind:9 connected-component reply threads (thread-context) and verify content-addressed /media/<sha256> attachments across 5 zero-trust security gates (media-inspect)
Audit Buzz Desktop 0.X and 1.0 installations on Windows for NTFS Buzz.exe/buzz.exe PE subsystem collisions and embedded WebView frontend assets
Configure subscription-first ACP coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Goose) with stripped API keys, require_mention loop guards, NIP-AE memory engrams, and SQLite outbox bridges
examples: Check why my Buzz agent is getting HTTP 403 on channels list even though the relay is healthy
Map the Buzz CLI commands for managing multi-repo NIP-MP projects, channel canvases, and NIP-AE agent memory
Generate a production Docker Compose stack and zero-downtime migration rehearsal plan for our self-hosted Buzz relay
Audit our Windows Buzz Desktop install to make sure Buzz 1.0 did not overwrite the console buzz.exe CLI
Run a disposable message canary and owner-access governance audit across our Buzz community channels
exclusions: Do not pass Nostr private keys (nsec1... or hex64) on command-line argument vectors
Do not deploy floating ghcr.io/block/buzz:latest container tags without verifying SQLx migration ceilings against a cloned staging database
